guide_wording: For each taxable transaction, establish the **base excluding IPSI**, select the actual local rate at the tax point, and calculate `tax=base×rate/100`. Add the quotas for the relevant return and subtract only separately justified deductible IPSI. Exempt or outside-scope transactions require their own legal basis and are not a zero-rate default. If the agreed price already includes IPSI, recover the base as `inclusive_price/(1+rate/100)` and the tax as the difference. Split supplies with different rates before calculating; do not apply an average rate to the turnover. [Ley8/1991 arts14–19](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1991-7645); [Ceuta arts26–29,32–34](https://www.ceuta.es/ceuta/component/jdownloads/finish/1583-enero/9410-bocce-extra2-30-01-2019?Itemid=534); [Melilla arts11–16](https://bomemelilla.es/bome/descargar/BOME-A-2021-410.pdf)
